scope: Current evidence-acquisition plan, not an original run record or site qualification. No authenticated measurements from the proposed installation have been supplied.

sources.title: Enapter Flex120 rev08 · manufacturer specification
sources.applies: Nominal performance and stated reference conditions for this edition.
sources.boundary: No measured part-load map, external cooler duty or site commissioning record. Search results and older editions report different figures; retain the exact edition.

sources.title: JRC122565 · electrolyser test protocols
sources.applies: Method guidance on system boundaries, operating conditions and stressor tests across electrolyser technologies.
sources.boundary: A test protocol supplies no calibration measurements for this equipment.

sources.title: IEA PVPS / Sandia · module validation data
sources.applies: Measured module characterization and outdoor irradiance, temperature, wind and electrical data; useful for separate method qualification.
sources.boundary: Different modules/site; not this Trina array. Existing analysis keeps the supplied time labels without claiming UTC; no implicit import into an hourly site run.

sources.title: Veatch et al. · measured PEM electrolysis dataset
sources.applies: Separate power/flow channels illustrate why metering boundaries and sensor disagreements matter.
sources.boundary: PEM research equipment is not an AEM Flex120 skid. Existing fitted parameters and validation results are not transferred to this candidate.

requests.title: Identify equipment and measurement boundaries
requests.records: Serials, configuration and firmware; meter locations, calibration/uncertainty, time synchronization, units, interval conventions and gas-flow reference conditions. Record actual weather, commands and initial inventories.
requests.use: Separate productive power from startup, internal utilities, external AC loads and DC conversion. Review whether a recorded simulation and measurement describe the same operation.
requests.gap: No plant-specific metering or commissioning record supplied.

requests.title: Converter and external cooler envelopes
requests.records: OEM converter efficiency/capacity versus load and ambient; electrolyser coolant flow and inlet/outlet temperature, coolant properties, external cooler electric demand and permitted ambient envelope. Include low load and hot conditions.
requests.use: Compare AC/DC energy and independently established thermal duty. A single electric meter cannot identify both heat rejection and cooler efficiency.
requests.gap: Constant efficiency, thermal duty and cooler limits remain uncalibrated.

requests.title: Electrolysis and methanation operating envelope
requests.records: Identified reactor/catalyst; feed composition/pressure, hydrogen and methane flow, reactor temperature, heating/cooling input, startup state and run restrictions. Separate stable operating windows from starts and trips.
requests.use: Check productive energy and thermal response before fitting an adapter. Retain independent evaluation periods and an explicit applicability envelope.
requests.gap: Reference sheet is a nominal point; the reactor remains illustrative.

requests.title: Water, gas and service logistics
requests.records: Tank calibration, delivered/accepted/rejected quantities, water quality, delivery timestamps, lead times, access/isolation requirements and intervention outcomes tied to the serviced equipment.
requests.use: Check finite supply balances and whether assumed recovery tasks are actually supported. Compare regimes with exhausted stock and disrupted deliveries.
requests.gap: No support contract, observed delivery history or repair-capability approval supplied.

requests.title: Dated installed and operating costs
requests.records: Itemised converter, cooling, conditioning, storage and commissioning quotations; maintenance scope, callout terms, consumables, disposal and delivery charges.
requests.use: Separate additional installed cost from existing asset allowances and variable decisions. Keep rejected-delivery commercial terms explicit.
requests.gap: Blank prices remain missing, not zero.

review_rule: Freeze the measurement boundary, applicability rationale, time split and numerical criteria before evaluation. Criteria are user-authored; passing them is not an independent certification. Observed-only fitting and held-out adapter deployment require a separately reviewed mechanism. Existing research stays attached to its original sources and versions.
